timeline_facts.claim: Dad was living and working in Adelaide, South Australia when discussing the scholarship idea with Sơ Nien.
In 1996 Dad met Đoàn Minh Nam during a trip through Cao Bằng, Bắc Cạn, Lạng Sơn and Hạ Long.
In 1997 Dad returned to Vietnam and discussed scholarship details with Đoàn Minh Nam at SunWay Hotel in Hanoi.
The first supported group consisted of 8 students.
The first program name was Stevenson Scholarship Programme.
In 2006 Đoàn Minh Nam transferred the work to Nguyễn Hoàng Cung and the program changed to the Viet Uc Family name.
Support is unconditional and carries no repayment obligation.

fictional_only: Dad going to Vietnam to conquer a buffalo
forbidden_as_current_fact: By 2027 over 1000 students have already been supported
render_fail_conditions: Dad is labeled or narrated as American, from America, from the USA, or from the United States.
A United States map, flag, landmark or label is used to establish Dad's origin.
Recent archive imagery is presented as if photographed in 1996, 1997 or 2006.
The fictional kangaroo/buffalo beats are presented as biography rather than clearly fictional comedy.
